category.name: Watermark
category.preferred_workflow: Create any required input files (documents, images) programmatically, load the Document, configure the appropriate WatermarkOptions, invoke Document.Watermark.SetText or SetImage with a file path or stream, and finally save the document to the desired format. For cell-level watermarks, add the watermark shape to the target cell after removing it from the header, ensuring the shape is inline to preserve layout.

strict_api_bans: Do not reference members that are not present in the Aspose.Words 26.10.0 API, such as WatermarkLayout, TextBox.Text, or Shape.Transparency.
canonical_patterns: Use Document.Watermark.SetText(string, TextWatermarkOptions) for text watermarks and Document.Watermark.SetImage(string, ImageWatermarkOptions) for image watermarks.
When inserting a watermark into a table cell, retrieve the watermark shape from the primary header, detach it, set WrapType to Inline, and append it to the target cell's first paragraph.
nullable_warning_prevention: Validate that image files exist before calling SetImage, and ensure that options objects are instantiated before use.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compilation fails with CS1503 because a string or stream is passed where an SKBitmap is expected.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code uses the overload that requires a SkiaSharp.SKBitmap instead of the overload that accepts a file path or stream.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Call Document.Watermark.SetImage(string path, ImageWatermarkOptions) or SetImage(Stream stream, ImageWatermarkOptions) as demonstrated in the verified examples.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Always select the overload that matches the argument type; consult the API reference for the correct signatures.

common_failure_patterns.pattern: Reference to non-existent types or members
common_failure_patterns.symptom: Build errors such as CS0246, CS1061, or CS0117 indicate missing types like Table, Cell, WatermarkLayout, or members like Shape.Text.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code invents or assumes APIs that are not part of the current Aspose.Words version.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Remove invented references and use only documented types (DocumentBuilder, Table, Cell, Shape) and members (WrapType, FillColor, etc.).
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Rely exclusively on the official Aspose.Words documentation and the verified code snippets for supported members.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compilation fails with CS0138 because a type is treated as a namespace in a using statement.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code attempts to write "using Watermark;" or similar, treating the Watermark class as a namespace.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Remove the invalid using directive; reference the Watermark class directly via the Document instance.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Only include using statements for actual namespaces; never use a class name in a using directive.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: CS0200 errors occur when the code tries to assign to Shape.TextBox or its Text property.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The TextBox property of Shape is read-only, and its Text member does not exist in this API version.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Create a Shape, set its properties (Width, Height, FillColor, etc.), and add a Run with the desired text inside a Paragraph appended to the shape.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Do not attempt to modify Shape.TextBox; instead build the watermark content using Paragraph and Run objects.

narrative.overview: The Watermark category demonstrates how to apply text and image watermarks to Word documents using Aspose.Words 26.10.0. Verified examples cover document-level, table-cell-level, batch, and combined watermark scenarios with correct API usage.
narrative.purpose: Provide an AI coding agent with concise guidance for generating reliable watermark code snippets that load or create documents, configure TextWatermarkOptions or ImageWatermarkOptions, apply the watermark via Document.Watermark, and persist the result while handling resources safely.
validation_priorities: Confirm that the output file is created and that the document contains the expected watermark without throwing exceptions.
maintenance_notes: Periodically verify that the Watermark API signatures have not changed in newer Aspose.Words releases and update the examples accordingly.
